modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Compound Words Lessons
modules.instructions: Master compound verbs (babysit, proofread) and compound adjectives (well-known, user-friendly). Understand hyphenation rules and formation patterns.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using compound verbs and hyphenated adjectives. Apply compound word rules in descriptive and narrative contexts.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Compound Word Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice identifying compound structures, choosing correct hyphenation, and matching word combinations.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Compound Words Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply hyphenation rules correctly. Master spelling of closed, hyphenated, and open compound forms.
